sql: SELECT l.k, r.payload FROM (VALUES (CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)), (1)) AS l(k) INNER JOIN (VALUES (CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), 99), (1, 10)) AS r(k, payload) ON l.k = r.k ORDER BY l.k
SELECT l.k, r.payload FROM (VALUES (CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)), (1)) AS l(k) LEFT JOIN (VALUES (1, 10)) AS r(k, payload) ON l.k = r.k ORDER BY l.k NULLS FIRST
